title: Fully-dynamic X.509 enrollment over 1-hop TSCH (server reconstructs DER at runtime)

test.description: 1-hop fully-dynamic X.509 enrollment. node1 = CA/EDHOC responder + RPL root + TSCH coordinator, built ENROLL_X509_DYN=1 so /crts and /sen reconstruct the X.509 DER at runtime via x509_encode_full_cert() (uECC point-decompression backend) instead of shipping static blobs. node2 = same multihop X.509 enroll client as the static arm (validates full DER-SEQUENCE completeness). Proves the lossless C509->X.509 converter end-to-end on the enrollment path.
